fix: In existing bg-externe-signalen Edge Function: status-code-aware one-shot DataForSEO recovery, deterministic shorter keyword only for search-engine internal 40101/40103, one exact-payload retry for known transient 5xx, no retries for billing/auth/invalid input. prevention_rules: Never treat HTTP 200 alone as DataForSEO success: require outer and task status_code=20000; a true 40102 no-results response is zero results, not synthetic data.
Do not retry 401/402/403, billing, account verification or invalid input; do not exceed one additional provider call per failed topic.
Never rerun already-successful topics in a manual recovery; require the latest producer observation for the requested topic to be a failure and use the existing Powerhouse scheduler token.
On replay, keep canonical observation fingerprints distinct from normal scheduled runs, and preserve all actual provider and source provenance.
Retain the same source catalog, canonical Brain error memory, protected Required + CodeQL, original scheduler and tenant-isolated portal; no second queue, CRM or outbound send.
terminal_rule: Exact-head Required+CodeQL, protected main merge, actual Supabase Edge version/readback, canonical one-topic replay with provider HTTP 200 and persisted source observation. Mark single-topic recovery PROVEN only with genuine provider evidence; total 44-topic future coverage and paid sales attribution are separately unproven.
